title: Portfolio Project Manifest
description: Contents of .portfolio/project.json in a project repository. The portfolio at your-domain.example fetches this file at build time and renders it as https://your-domain.example/projects/<slug>. Every field is optional; anything omitted falls back to the entry already in the portfolio's settings.json.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Set to this schema URL for autocomplete.

manifestVersion.description: Manifest format version. Use 2. Version 1 files keep working — 2 only adds fields (icon, readme, appearance, media.video, media.layout).

slug.description: URL segment for the project page. Defaults to the repository name, lowercased. Changing this after the page is indexed loses its search ranking — pick once.

tagline.description: One line under the title. Not a sentence — a label.

summary.description: Two or three sentences. Used as the page meta description, so lead with what the project does, not with why it was built.

icon.description: react-icons component name for the project, e.g. "SiRust", "FaPython", "SiFastapi". Used on the project card and page header. A name the icon set does not contain falls back to the language/technology guess, so it degrades rather than breaking.

role.description: What you did on it, if the repo is not solo work.

end.description: YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or null while ongoing

highlights.description: Bullet points. Concrete outcomes beat adjectives.

metrics.description: Numbers worth putting on a card. Both fields are required or the entry is dropped at build time.

links.description: Only http(s) URLs are rendered; anything else is dropped by the page.

cover.description: Absolute URL. Relative repo paths do not resolve — the page is served from your-domain.example, not from the repo.

screenshots.description: Shown as a carousel when there is more than one, unless media.layout says otherwise.

layout.description: How screenshots are laid out. "auto" (the default) means a carousel for two or more, a single figure for one.

video.description: One demo video, shown above the screenshots. Only these hosts embed: youtube.com, youtu.be, vimeo.com. Any other https URL is treated as a direct video file and must end in .mp4, .webm or .ogg — anything else is dropped at build time.

poster.description: Absolute image URL. Only used for direct video files, not for embeds.

readme.description: Render this repository's README (or another Markdown file) below the page body. `true` is shorthand for the object with its defaults.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the Markdown file. Defaults to README.md. Must stay inside the repo — no leading slash, no "..".

collapsed.description: Render it behind a "Read more" toggle instead of expanded. Default false.

appearance.description: Optional look of this one project page. Every key is a closed vocabulary, not CSS — omit the block entirely and the portfolio's own styling applies, which is the right default for almost every project.

theme.description: Page gradient. "default" is the portfolio's purple.

background.description: Texture drawn over the gradient. "default" means whatever the portfolio uses.

accent.description: Six-digit hex, e.g. "#dea584". Tints the title rule, chips and links. Anything that is not exactly this shape is ignored.

sections.description: The body of the page, in order. A section whose type is not in the enum is dropped at build time rather than rendered.

body.description: prose: plain text paragraphs separated by a blank line (Markdown is not parsed). code: the snippet itself, rendered verbatim without syntax highlighting.

url.description: media: absolute http(s) URL of one image. Anything else is dropped.

seo.description: Overrides for the page head. Leave unset unless the summary makes a bad meta description.

image.description: Social card image. Overrides media.cover for og:image only.
